title: cyanthillium hookerianum
intro: Cyanthillium hookerianum, commonly known as the Hooker's cotton wool, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a shrub-like plant known for its medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cyanthillium hookerianum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
